sample_unit: 3-day AI-generated dietary plans (3 disorders x 2 models)

links.outcome: Whether LLM diet plans meet disease-specific metabolic targets versus general nutritional adequacy
links.effect: Both models produced generally acceptable overall nutrition but missed disease-specific targets in all three disorders; conventional adequacy measures were insufficient to judge clinical appropriateness.
links.quote: These findings demonstrated that conventional measures of nutritional adequacy alone were insufficient to determine the clinical appropriateness of AI-generated dietary plans for inherited protein metabolism disorders.

unlisted_practices: Disease-specific benchmarking of AI-generated dietary plans against metabolic nutrition guidelines (GMDI)

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy and safety of LLM-generated diet plans across pediatric metabolic disorder vignettes without testing a deployment practice or organizational safeguard.
